thread:
miguel: FYI last night's PP perf run shows the PP bubble almost doubled for long-chat workloads (seq=2048) on 8xA100. microbatch=4, 1F1B.

tess: ugh. did the model switch kernels? kernel selection sometimes flips for >1024 and that kills overlap.

miguel: good call — profiler shows a different attention kernel for the same model when seq>1536. also saw higher all-reduce time.

sam: paste of the quick summary from nvprof/nsys run:
```
Profile summary (8xA100, microbatch=4, 1F1B)
stage compute avg: 14.8 ms
all-reduce avg: 9.3 ms  <-- increased vs baseline 4.1 ms
bubble wait avg: 12.1 ms
end-to-end token: 46.2 ms
KV cache hit rate: 18%
```

diane: KV hit rate low because tests were multi-turn cold-start. That'll up microbatch pressure and increase inter-stage imbalance.

tess: so two vectors: (1) kernel selection change (attention kernel fallback) and (2) all-reduce overhead + poor comm/compute overlap causing larger bubble.

miguel: reproduction command I used:
```
./run_profiler --model rwin-3b --pp 8 --microbatch 4 --seq-len 2048 --profile nsys --nvprof-flags "--details"
```

sam: quick experiments to try:
- force the optimized attention kernel (toggle kernel selector flag) and re-run
- bump microbatch to 8 to see if 1F1B amortizes all-reduce latency
- enable NCCL async progress / use separate comm stream to overlap all-reduce

tess: I tried forcing the kernel and bubble dropped ~25%, but all-reduce still dominates. with microbatch=8 we got another ~18% drop but tail latency increased for short requests.

diane: can we try RPC routing to balance seq-lengths at the batching layer? batching heuristics could avoid mixing 2k seq with 256 seq in same batch.

miguel: agreed. current heuristic groups by model only. adding coarse bucket by seq-range might help. Also need to avoid tiny tensor all-reduces by packing small gradients/activations when possible.

ci-bot: build #5472 passed - added NCCL env toggle support and kernel-forcing flag to runtime.

sam: next steps (owners):
- tess: run 1F1B tuning matrix (microbatch=[2,4,8,16], seq=[512,1024,1536,2048]) and record bubble/allreduce timings
- diane: prototype seq-bucketing in batching layer and run a quick A/B
- miguel: test async-allreduce via comm stream + NCCL env toggles, collect nsys traces

tess: will start matrix tonight. initial target is to get bubble within 10% of baseline for seq<=2048 without hurting short-request p95.

miguel: if async all-reduce helps, we can flip default to overlap mode for Dedicated and expose flag for Hosted.

sam: thanks. keep logs short in this thread. paste nsys flame snippets in #eng-runtime when ready :thumbsup:
